name: Tokyo Shibuya Fly VR
summary:
Welcome to Tokyo Shibuya Sky, a thrilling VR experience that starts off calm and ends with a heart-pounding surprise.

At first, you’re simply sitting back, enjoying the bustling atmosphere of Shibuya right in front of its famous station. But then—out of nowhere—your floating chair (or maybe a cart?) suddenly takes off, soaring into the sky before you even realize what’s happening.
